content.text: Philadelphia Phillies left-hander Christopher Sanchez (29) signs a new contract.The Phillies announced on the 22nd that they had agreed to a six-year contract with Sanchez. The contract starts in 2027 and applies until 2032, with team options for 2033.According to local media such as The Athletic, the contract is worth $107 million (161.1955 billion won) for six years. Sanchez tied the Korean team tightly in the last WBC quarterfinals. 사진=ⓒAFPBBNews = News1 Sanchez signed a club-friendly contract with the Phillies in June 2024 that included a team option for the 2029 ($14 million) 2030 ($15 million) season for four years and $22.5 million. And the agreement on a new contract this time.After the existing contract agreement, the performance became the trigger for the new contract. Sanchez pitched 1,81 2/3 innings in 31 games in the 2024 season, going 11-9 with a 3.32 ERA and being selected as an All-Star.The 2025 season surpassed him last year. He pitched 202 innings in 32 games and spent his career high season with a 13-5 record and 2.50 ERA, ranking second in voting for the Cy Young Award.In March, he represented the Dominican Republic at the World Baseball Classic (WBC).In the quarterfinals against South Korea, he also became the starting pitcher and completely blocked the national team's batters with two hits, one walk, and eight strikeouts in five innings. Christopher Sanchez has done well over the past two years. Photo = MK Sports DB It is clear that he has performed well, but it is clear that it is uncommon to agree to a new contract less than two years after the contract agreement.In an interview with The Athletic, his agent Jean Mato acknowledged the club's efforts, saying, "John (owner John Middleton) and Dave (president Dave Dombrowski) decided to take a bold step forward and give them the right treatment even though the club secured control for five years at a minimum cost."[FINIX (USA) = KIM JAE HO, MK Sports Correspondent]
